import pdfplumber
import os

base = r'C:\Demo\DS-WorkBuddy'
files = [
    'CSC2103-L01-analysis-arrays-linked-lists.pdf',
    'CSC2103-L02-hash-tables.pdf',
    'CSC2103-L03-bst-and-avl-trees.pdf',
    'CSC2103-L04-binary-heaps.pdf',
    'past-paper.pdf'
]

for f in files:
    path = os.path.join(base, f)
    print(f'===== {f} =====')
    with pdfplumber.open(path) as pdf:
        print(f'Pages: {len(pdf.pages)}')
        for i, page in enumerate(pdf.pages):
            text = page.extract_text() or ''
            print(f'--- Slide {i+1} ---')
            print(text[:2000])
            if len(text) > 2000:
                print(f'... ({len(text)} chars total)')
            print()
    print()
